name: mobile-ide
description: Phone-first remote IDE for coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, any ACP agent): a Node daemon on your dev box + an Expo app.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:server && pnpm run build:studio && pnpm run build:web

//: build: core + daemon, the Studio bundle (apps/studio/dist, served at /studio/), then `expo export -p web` into apps/mobile/dist — the daemon serves that folder at / (see docs/RUNBOOK.md step 2).
dev: daemon (tsx, hot restart) + `expo start --web` together with one Ctrl-C (scripts/dev.sh); the daemon still serves the last export at /.
